limitations: Frozen input and metadata projection, no production source/basis validation.
Two pressure scopes, 12 correlated queries; copied papers, no independent real 2k corpus.
Local graph changes topology and local ID numbering; effects cannot be attributed to selector alone.
One build seed and insertion order, no build variance estimate.
FlatIP is float32 inner product, not sequential float64 cosine oracle.
Each query recomputes scope, reads actual vectors, recomputes reference scores and aggregates Top100.
Three repeats are timings, quality is 12 queries only; oracle validation excluded from timing.
Subset setup and disk cost are separate, prebuilt queries are not dynamic query latency.
Whole-harness memory includes global graph, oracle, metadata and allocator retention.
No engine selection, production lifecycle, seven-platform, concurrency or multilingual acceptance.
